{"task": {"id": "I_kwDOLEgSIs8AAAABZh1bHQ", "item_id": "PVTI_lAHOAHSLSM4Bm7fazhDIvBs", "project_id": "PVT_kwHOAHSLSM4Bm7fa", "number": 51, "title": "Provide useful room planes and validate pinned AR plane consumers", "body": "## Problem

At `dev` revision `aa568ff9e61bb8778388eb8602c7ff9f1efd6523`, `environment.ts` exposes one XRPlane per room triangle, centered at its centroid with an axis following its first edge. Pinned Three.js XRPlanes creates a rectangular proxy centered at that origin using polygon extents. This can introduce shifted coverage, overlap and tessellation artifacts. Existing assertions establish triangle reconstruction and populated collections, but do not establish useful room-plane rendering or placement.

Plane bindings also remain incomplete: public constructors permit allocation, readonly setlike operations lack interface conversion and receiver checks, aliases differ, and empty-set `forEach` skips callback validation.

## Expected outcome

Expose useful deterministic virtual-room planes and complete their application-facing bindings and lifecycle. Demonstrate correctly aligned plane visualization in both pinned consumers and anchor placement in the Sample on Chromium and Firefox, for Quest MR and Android AR. This is a bounded improvement within the fixed compatibility goal; remaining mesh and deferred-module work stays in scope.

## Context

Target `dev`. Relevant files include `src/polyfill/api/{environment,runtime,interface-brand}.ts`, `ARScene.ts`, `EmulatedXRDevice.ts`, `CustomWebXRPolyfill.ts`, `assets/hall_empty.glb`, and the environment/browser fixtures.

Use [Planes 394f13e](https://github.com/immersive-web/plane-detection/blob/394f13ee76d31f3885eb1237777cf2ecb1b87cbc/index.bs), [Device CRD, 9 June 2026](https://www.w3.org/TR/2026/CRD-webxr-20260609/), [Anchors d9c6266](https://github.com/immersive-web/anchors/blob/d9c6266d5e28caf98bff046dcbba31abd0b6d3f1/index.bs), and [WebIDL 622910c](https://github.com/whatwg/webidl/blob/622910c67c724e362f71e8255a0380bade261acb/index.bs).

Consumers: [Samples plane detection at fb41c34](https://github.com/immersive-web/webxr-samples/blob/fb41c3416496974672e2c766a41c6febcba2d07e/proposals/plane-detection.html), requiring `anchors` and `plane-detection`; [Three.js r186 plane detection at 9b4a2ac](https://github.com/mrdoob/three.js/blob/9b4a2ac29c63ccb43fd51c5661f2f873ac2c39b8/examples/webxr_ar_plane_detection.html), requiring `plane-detection`. The Sample uses Three.js 0.127.0; the extension dependency is 0.186.1. Preserve these distinct provenances.

All 50 existing Issues/PRs are closed. #19/#20 introduced triangle patches; historical Chromium results report 100 planes and 128 callbacks per AR profile, without pinned consumer provenance or meaningful placement evidence. #49/#50 improved pose/view contracts, without adding plane-consumer outcomes. These are reported executions, not current compatibility passes.

The pinned plane draft has conflicting timestamp text: attribute-change semantics versus unconditional assignment in its update algorithm. Retain change-only timestamps, corroborated by its prose and pinned WPT, and document this interpretation explicitly.

## Pre-merge acceptance

- [ ] Produce coherent planar regions from the existing room using a bounded deterministic representation. Cover useful horizontal floor and vertical wall regions. Shared triangulation edges must not cause duplicate rectangular proxies for a rectangular region. Use stable surface axes and centered origins suitable for the pinned consumer. Universal coplanar merging is unnecessary; preserve openings, disconnected regions and noncoplanar boundaries. Convex partitioning or authored surface metadata is acceptable.

- [ ] Independently validate rectangle, rotated rectangle, disconnected/opening and sloped fixtures. Reconstruct world geometry from polygon plus planeSpace; verify finite metre coordinates, local `y=0`, normal-aligned +Y and orientation/null classification. Measure polygon coverage and the exact pinned XRPlanes proxy footprint against known surfaces, including overlap, displacement and excess coverage. For rectangular fixtures, require boundary agreement within `1e-4` metres. Record packaged-room measurements and justify remaining approximation.

- [ ] Implement nonconstructible XRPlane/XRPlaneSet interfaces, branded readonly prototype getters and readonly setlike bindings. Preserve planeSpace identity and frozen polygon values. Provide `keys === values === Symbol.iterator`, insertion-order iteration, paired entries and callback arguments. Invalid receivers, forged/proxied interfaces, invalid `has` arguments and noncallable callbacks—including on empty sets—throw TypeError. Genuine cross-realm plane/set objects and borrowed operations work; a genuine nonmember plane returns false.

- [ ] Preserve session-owned plane identity while tracked, frame membership snapshots, shape-change timestamps and pose-only timestamp stability. Exercise shape changes, unavailable tracking, removal, reacquisition and shutdown. Removed spaces return null from valid active owning-frame pose queries; foreign-session spaces and inactive-frame access produce InvalidStateError. Invalid getter receivers produce TypeError before state checks. Retained readonly metadata remains readable.

- [ ] Keep `plane-detection` enabled only for the existing Quest MR/Android `immersive-ar` profiles. Unsupported required negotiation rejects NotSupportedError; unsupported optional requests are omitted. Unenabled active-frame collections remain empty. Complete branded `initiateRoomCapture()` Promise behavior: automatic first completion resolves, repeated or ended-session calls reject InvalidStateError, and an unenabled feature rejects NotSupportedError, with ended-state precedence. No manual sensor workflow is required.

- [ ] Execute both unchanged pinned applications on both AR profiles in both browsers: eight combinations through the actual extension and genuine panel route. Show identifiable application pixels, stereo Quest/mono Android output, room alignment under viewer movement, and Sample reticle/select-created anchor placement at a measured plane point. End and restart each scenario without stale tracking or presentation resources. The Sample's existing overlay checkbox may be disabled for this scope. Disclose observers and synthetic controls; do not replace returned geometry or patch application logic. Dynamic geometry assertions belong in the API fixture because pinned XRPlanes only creates/removes meshes.

- [ ] Extend existing focused drivers/fixtures rather than introducing unrelated infrastructure. Adapt applicable [WPT plane tests at e185958](https://github.com/web-platform-tests/wpt/tree/e1859580b5fcf74940a18d2f783296b4961035e3/webxr/plane-detection) with documented setup differences. Run `npm run build:firefox` (including typecheck/build), `npm run test:environment`, and the focused plane contract/application selections. Preserve affected mesh reconstruction, hit intersections, CPU-depth calibration, pose offsets and cleanup through targeted checks where shared code changes. Record actual commands, versions, tested source/bundle hashes, served consumer/dependency provenance, measurements, captures, failures, skips and unperformed checks. Test-source inspection alone earns no execution credit.

- [ ] Update the inventory and reproduction documentation with exact support and remaining limitations. The Coordinator owns implementation, validation and normal PR review. If primary evidence disproves an AI-authored requirement, retain its original assumption, correction, pinned source and rationale in the Issue/PR without human approval or independent AI re-review. Preserve meaningful geometry, rendering, placement and lifecycle acceptance.

## Optional validation

Additional irregular room regions or browser versions beyond the mandatory matrix.

## Required post-merge verification

None required.

## Specification reconciliation

This task was authored by AI under the agreed WebXR API compatibility goal for
Quest 3 VR/MR and Android AR. Correct erroneous technical assumptions or acceptance
criteria when primary specifications or measured evidence establish the correction.
Update this Issue and record the original
assumption, corrected requirement, primary reference and rationale in the PR.
These technical corrections require neither human approval nor an independent AI
re-review. Preserve the agreed goal and relevant pre-merge acceptance; do not weaken
requirements merely to accommodate incomplete implementation or failing tests.
